_comment: Curated polylines [[lon, lat], ...] for routes with "path". Suez Canal traced from ASTER GDEM shaded relief (NASA GIBS) on 2026-11-01. Nile, Blue Nile and White Nile chained from Natural Earth 10m rivers_lake_centerlines (public domain) on 2026-11-02, upstream to downstream. 'Nile from GERD' = the dam (35.093, 11.215) + Blue Nile downstream of it + Nile to Cairo (2026-11-03). Volga: Natural Earth 1:50m rivers_lake_centerlines (public domain), the 'Volga' river and lake centerline features chained from the source (32.60 E, 57.25 N) to the delta mouth (47.65 E, 45.66 N), points thinned to 0.05 degrees (269 points). Colorado River (source in Rocky Mountain NP to the delta, through the Lake Powell and Lake Mead centerlines) and Green River (Wyoming to the Colorado at 38.19 N): Natural Earth 10m rivers_lake_centerlines (public domain), chained 2026-11-04, points thinned to 0.02 deg. 'Green River from Flaming Gorge' = Flaming Gorge Dam (-109.4214, 40.9147) + the Green River downstream of it (2026-11-04). Central Arizona Project (Lake Havasu to south of Tucson, 543 km; one ~10 km gap at a tunnel bridged), Colorado River Aqueduct (Whitsett intake to Lake Mathews, 391 km) and All-American Canal (Imperial Dam to the Imperial Valley, 129 km): USGS National Hydrography Dataset flowlines (public domain, hydro.nationalmap.gov), chained 2026-11-04. Indus (from above Tarbela to the sea), Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas and Sutlej: Natural Earth 10m rivers_lake_centerlines (public domain), river and lake centerline parts chained upstream to downstream, points thinned to 0.02 deg (2026-11-08).
